Mapping depicts Brampton Plan-Schedule 2-Land Use Designations to guide development.  This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.

Brampton Plan Schedule 2 Land Use Designations identifies the general distribution and location of land uses across the city. The schedule provides the framework for managing growth and development by establishing areas intended for Neighbourhoods, NHS, Mixed Use, Employment, Provincial Highways, Mixed-Use Employment, Rural Land, and other land use functions.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
